## Description

Start the onboarding/vendor applications for the launch emirate HIE (Malaffi, NABIDH or Riayati) and claims platform (eClaimLink/Shafafiya), and record each programme's current requirements, sandbox access and conformance-test steps.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Applications submitted (or blocked reasons recorded) for the launch emirate exchange and claims platform.
- [ ] **AC2.** A tracker lists each programme's requirements, contacts and expected timeline; P5 tickets are updated with the findings.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).

## Sources

- PRD v2 §10 risk "Regulator onboarding slower than planned" (mitigation: start applications in P1)
